items.title: A Search whose token was refused (room picked clean, or no GM answered) could be rerolled into a granted item; a stash find would draw a second item from the room's table

The stash half has no object: a Search reaches into no stash since 1.2.112 (action-search.mjs:55-61, :578; reroll.mjs:1247-1249; commit feba55c3). Still open: `claimed` is one of the roller's claims (action-pipeline.mjs:532) and the replay reads only that; the GMs' own mark that a token was spent, `tokenSpentAt` (search-tokens.mjs:180-185), holds the first throw's find (sheet-audit.mjs:2326) and no line of reroll.mjs reads it.
items.pinned_by: tier 2 'a Reroll is paid and made on the GM: the player's browser writes neither Hope nor the message' bookmarks a Search with claimed: false and holds its Reroll to two lines (tests-tier2.mjs:5557-5598); nothing holds the replay to tokenSpentAt
items.still_wrong: A player whose Search was refused its token sends roll.bookmark once more for the same roll inside its minute, with claimed true or without the field, then asks for a Reroll: the primary GM draws from the room's table and puts the item on that player's sheet for 3 Hope, the room's tokens untouched and, on the unanswered or sealed branch, the action already handed back.
items.refutation_tried: Read the roll.bookmark row's guards (bridge-table.mjs:1088-1101: knownSender, notSpectator, owns, guardRollAuthor - the sender's own claimed roll under a minute old, bridge-guards.mjs:1169-1185), keepGmBookmark's patch of the same roll's claims (action-pipeline.mjs:677-690), replayBookmark (reroll.mjs:353-361), rerollRefusal and replayRefusal (reroll.mjs:408-437, :484-534: neither asks anything of a Search), and grepped tokenSpentAt: gm-stores.mjs, search-tokens.mjs and sheet-audit.mjs only.

The trust model's text (rules/trust-model.md in the agent folder) says a claim touches only the roller's own sheet and lists 'which item a Search draws' among what stays open; a replayed find with no token spent is not on its list.

new_observations.title: A Search's Reroll is held to the roller's claim that a token was taken, not to the GMs' own mark of it
new_observations.what: The first throw's find stands only on a Search the primary marked `tokenSpentAt` (sheet-audit.mjs:2326). The replay asks `bookmark.claimed === false` alone, and `claimed` is a claim a second roll.bookmark for the same roll may rewrite inside a minute (guardRollAuthor, bridge-guards.mjs:1169-1185). A packet a player's console could send therefore turns a refused Search into a draw from the room's table for 3 Hope, no token spent. Read in the source; not driven.

new_observations.title: A declined Direct Murder gives back one action whatever paid for it
new_observations.what: `ruleDeclineMurder` calls `refundAction(actor, 1)` with no receipt, and the GMs' card carries none; `spendAction` takes a banked Burst before an action (actions.mjs:178-187), so a declaration paid with a Burst comes back as an ordinary action. Every other refusal card names what paid (action-pipeline.mjs:1042-1058). Not established: whether the hour's reset after the Eclipse makes the difference moot.
